result_text:
The export now names the `all_files.zip` entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the export.

**Change:** `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in `aspectFileLists`. It used to hard-code the five `aspect_*.txt` names. It now takes the five configured aspects (`getMain()`, `getTest()`, `getGenerated()`, `getBuildAndDeployment()`, `getOther()`) and names each entry with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same function that names the loose files. Default names and order are unchanged. The `git-history.zip` write is in the same `try` block, so it is no longer skipped once `all_files.zip` succeeds.

**Test:** added `reports/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporterAspectFileListsTest.java` with two cases: the default names, and the renamed `buildAndDeployment` giving `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in the fourth place. Both pass with `mvn -o -pl reports test -Dtest=DataExporterAspectFileListsTest`.

I did not run a full end-to-end export, so `all_files.zip` and `git-history.zip` are verified only through the unit test. The broad `catch (Throwable t)` around the export is unchanged, so other failures there would still only show in the log.

Nothing was committed.
